# pve_sdn_route_maps (Data Source)

Configured FRR route maps: id index, flat entry list, and (optionally) all entries of one route map.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_route_maps" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `pending` (Boolean) Display pending config.
- `route_map_id` (String) The SDN route map identifier
- `running` (Boolean) Display running config.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/sdn/route-maps/entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <route_map_id>.
- `route_map` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/sdn/route-maps/entries/{route-map-id}. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--route_map))
- `route_maps` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/sdn/route-maps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--route_maps))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Matching policy of a route map entry.
- `call` (String) The SDN route map identifier
- `digest` (String) Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.
- `exit_action` (String)
- `match` (List of String)
- `order` (Number) The index of this route map entry
- `route_map_id` (String) The SDN route map identifier
- `set` (List of String)
